decisiveFindings: Both runs are completed success at the exact immutable public head with all four jobs and all eight steps per job successful.

All four original report ZIPs exactly match independently fetched GitHub API artifact IDs, sizes and SHA256 digests; central/local framing, CRCs, unique regular safe members and cross-report identities pass.

Each native report binds the exact public runtime archive, manifest, own SDK and all four exact worker hashes to successful open-edit-save-reopen, preserved content, stale revision rejection, dirty state after failed save, retry and Unicode/space paths under empty PATH.

The macOS and Windows reports contain their separately scoped real OS network controls. Windows exact-path identity and cleanup/restoration/service state pass rather than merely asserting cleanupVerified.
All 44 exact fixed public reconstruction data records match individual anonymous full-readback results, including original source archive identity.
highestLeverageRemainingGap: No material gap in this component threshold. Complete-source packaging, durable CI-receipt publication and independent whole-artifact integration acceptance remain root responsibilities.
confidence: High for the declared component threshold, bounded by the public CI evidence trust boundary and stated targets.
limitations: This is a component evidence review of actual public GitHub Actions runs, not a new local rerun of foreign target binaries.
The observed targets are macos-15 arm64, macos-15-intel x64 and windows-2022 x64. Windows Server 2022 is not Windows 11 client acceptance.

Windows Defender Firewall proof is scoped to Node and four exact worker executable paths; arbitrary descendants and OS-wide isolation are not admitted. The inner NOT_ENFORCED field is explicitly supplied by the validated outer driver.
macOS positive TCP and EPERM probes validate the same inherited sandbox-exec deny network* profile used by actual worker qualification.
Grid rendering is explicitly UNSUPPORTED and correctly reported false; the other three workers return valid PNGs. This does not accept every optional engine feature.

The forty-four reconstruction data assets passed complete anonymous size and SHA256 readback during run 42402918764; this admits byte availability and identity at that run, not their runtime behavior.

The admitted original source archive has 4889 manifest files. Final complete-source packaging, durable publication of these CI receipts and whole-artifact integration review remain separate root work.
No offline source rebuild, private WebView/host integration, Microsoft/Adobe parity, whole-product/file parity or production acceptance is granted.
Independent source and API reads used the GitHub connector. GitHub-hosted job execution and original artifact SHA256 metadata are the evidence trust boundary; the critic did not build the candidate.

passes.result: Both successful actual run/head/jobs/artifacts sets and all native/data report semantics admitted. Source TAR normalization and expected corrupt-deflate rejection were corrected in the critic harness.

passes.focus: Domain reread of immutable public driver and source closure

All positive captures still pass; final reread found no material remaining issue within the exact three-native and forty-four-data threshold. Preserved Windows Server/per-executable, byte-only reconstruction and non-parity limits. Removed expected fixture warning from successful checker output.
